items.source: TransactionalTestExecutionListener expects a PlatformTransactionManager bean to be defined in the Spring ApplicationContext for the test. In case there are multiple instances of PlatformTransactionManager within the test's ApplicationContext, a qualifier may be declared via @Transactional (for example, @Transactional("myTxMgr") or @Transactional(transactionManager = "myTxMgr"), or TransactionManagementConfigurer can be implemented by an @Configuration class. See TestContextTransactionUtils.retrieveTransactionManager(TestContext, String) for details on the algorithm used to look up a transaction manager in the test's ApplicationContext.
items.translation: TransactionalTestExecutionListener 期望在测试的 Spring ApplicationContext 中定义一个 PlatformTransactionManager Bean。如果在测试的 ApplicationContext 中存在多个 PlatformTransactionManager 实例，可以通过 @Transactional 声明一个 限定符（例如，@Transactional("myTxMgr") 或 @Transactional(transactionManager = "myTxMgr")），或者由一个 @Configuration 类实现 TransactionManagementConfigurer。有关在测试的 ApplicationContext 中查找事务管理器的算法详情，请参阅 TestContextTransactionUtils.retrieveTransactionManager(TestContext, String)。

items.source: Annotating a test method with @Transactional causes the test to be run within a transaction that will, by default, be automatically rolled back after completion of the test. If a test class is annotated with @Transactional, each test method within that class hierarchy or nested class hierarchy will be run within a transaction. Test methods that are not annotated with @Transactional (at the class or method level) will not be run within a transaction. Furthermore, tests that are annotated with @Transactional but have the propagation type set to NOT_SUPPORTED or NEVER will not be run within a transaction.
items.translation: 为测试方法添加 `@Transactional` 注解会导致该测试在事务中运行，默认情况下，测试完成后该事务将自动回滚。如果测试类被添加了 `@Transactional` 注解，则该类的类层次结构或嵌套类层次结构中的每个测试方法都将在事务中运行。未添加 `@Transactional` 注解（在类或方法级别）的测试方法不会在事务中运行。此外，虽然添加了 `@Transactional` 注解但传播类型设置为 propagation NOT_SUPPORTED 或 NEVER 的测试不会在事务中运行。

items.source: Test-managed transactions are transactions that are managed declaratively via this listener or programmatically via TestTransaction. Such transactions should not be confused with Spring-managed transactions (i.e., those managed directly by Spring within the ApplicationContext loaded for tests) or application-managed transactions (i.e., those managed programmatically within application code that is invoked via tests). Spring-managed and application-managed transactions will typically participate in test-managed transactions; however, caution should be taken if Spring-managed or application-managed transactions are configured with any propagation type other than REQUIRED or SUPPORTS.
items.translation: 测试管理的交易是指通过此监听器以声明方式或通过TestTransaction以编程方式管理的交易。此类交易不应与Spring 管理的交易（即由 Spring 在测试加载的ApplicationContext内直接管理的交易）或应用管理的交易（即在通过测试调用的应用程序代码中以编程方式管理的交易）相混淆。Spring 管理和应用管理的交易通常将参与测试管理的交易；但是，如果 Spring 管理的应用程序管理的交易配置了除REQUIRED或SUPPORTS之外的任何传播类型，则应谨慎处理。

items.source: When executing transactional tests, it is sometimes useful to be able to execute certain set up or tear down code outside a transaction. TransactionalTestExecutionListener provides such support for methods annotated with @BeforeTransaction or @AfterTransaction. As of Spring Framework 4.3, @BeforeTransaction and @AfterTransaction may also be declared on Java 8 based interface default methods.
items.translation: 在执行事务性测试时，有时需要能够在事务之外执行某些设置或清理代码。TransactionalTestExecutionListener为使用@BeforeTransaction或@AfterTransaction注解的方法提供了此类支持。自 Spring Framework 4.3 起，@BeforeTransaction和@AfterTransaction也可声明在基于 Java 8 的接口默认方法上。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 4.1, it is possible to interact with test-managed transactions programmatically via the static methods in TestTransaction. TestTransaction may be used within test methods, before methods, and after methods.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 4.1 起，可以通过 TestTransaction 中的静态方法以编程方式与测试管理的事务进行交互。TestTransaction 可用于 test 方法、before 方法和 after 方法中。

items.source: By default, test transactions will be automatically rolled back after completion of the test; however, transactional commit and rollback behavior can be configured declaratively via the @Commit and @Rollback annotations at the class level and at the method level.
items.translation: 默认情况下，测试事务将在测试完成后自动回滚；然而，可以通过在类级别和方法级别使用@Commit和@Rollback注解以声明方式配置事务提交和回滚行为。

items.translation: 支持在类级别使用@Rollback或@Commit。

items.source: Note that if a @BeforeTransaction method fails, any remaining @BeforeTransaction methods will not be invoked, and a transaction will not be started.
items.translation: 注意，如果 `@BeforeTransaction` 方法失败，则剩余的 `@BeforeTransaction` 方法将不会被调用，并且不会启动事务。

items.source: The default implementation simply delegates to TestContextTransactionUtils.retrieveTransactionManager(TestContext, String).
items.translation: 默认实现只是委托给 TestContextTransactionUtils.retrieveTransactionManager(TestContext, String)。

items.source: @AfterTransaction methods are guaranteed to be invoked even if an error occurs while ending the transaction.
items.translation: @AfterTransaction 方法即使在结束事务时发生错误，也保证会被调用。

items.source: Run all @BeforeTransaction methods for the specified test context. If one of the methods fails, however, the caught exception will be rethrown in a wrapped RuntimeException, and the remaining methods will not be given a chance to execute.
items.translation: 运行指定测试上下文中的所有@BeforeTransaction注解接口方法。然而，如果其中一个方法失败，捕获的异常将在包装后的RuntimeException中重新抛出，其余的方法将不会获得执行机会。

items.source: If a transaction is currently active for the supplied test context, this method will end the transaction and run @AfterTransaction methods.
items.translation: 如果为提供的测试上下文当前存在活动事务，此方法将结束该事务并运行 @AfterTransaction 方法。

items.source: If the test method of the supplied test context is configured to run within a transaction, this method will run @BeforeTransaction methods and start a new transaction.
items.translation: 如果提供的 测试上下文 的测试方法配置为在事务中运行，则此方法将运行 @BeforeTransaction 方法并启动一个新的事务。

items.source: Run all @AfterTransaction methods for the specified test context.
items.translation: 运行指定测试上下文中的所有@AfterTransaction注解接口方法。

items.source: Run all @BeforeTransaction methods for the specified test context.
items.translation: 运行指定测试上下文的所有@BeforeTransaction注解接口方法。

items.source: Run all @AfterTransaction methods for the specified test context. If one of the methods fails, the caught exception will be logged as an error, and the remaining methods will be given a chance to execute. After all methods have executed, the first caught exception, if any, will be rethrown.
items.translation: 运行指定测试上下文中的所有@AfterTransaction注解接口方法。如果其中一个方法失败，捕获的异常将作为错误记录，其余方法仍有机会执行。所有方法执行完毕后，如果有捕获到的异常，第一个捕获的异常将被重新抛出。
